# oh-my-claudecode v5.7.0: show Claude Code, tighten skill prose, rename shipyard glossary

## Release Notes

Release with **4 new features**, **45 bug fixes**, **9 other changes** across **59 merged PRs**.

### Highlights

- **feat(hud): show Claude Code effort level** (#4249) — thanks @bengry
- **feat(skills): tighten skill prose and prompt guardrails** (#4271) — thanks @pangpang778
- **feat: rename shipyard glossary slot CONTEXT.md to GLOSSARY.md** (#4273) — thanks @pangpang778
- **feat(skills): add session flow map** (#4319)

### New Features

- **feat(hud): show Claude Code effort level** (#4249) — thanks @bengry
- **feat(skills): tighten skill prose and prompt guardrails** (#4271) — thanks @pangpang778
- **feat: rename shipyard glossary slot CONTEXT.md to GLOSSARY.md** (#4273) — thanks @pangpang778
- **feat(skills): add session flow map** (#4319)

### Install / Update

The npm CLI and the Claude Code marketplace/plugin are separate install tracks, not either/or replacements. Update whichever track you use; if you have both installed, update both. CLI-dependent skill paths such as `ask` and CLI-backed `team` require the `omc` CLI from the npm package.

**CLI / runtime:**

```bash
npm install -g oh-my-claude-sisyphus@5.7.0
```

**Claude Code plugin:**

```text
/plugin marketplace update omc
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode/compare/v5.6.2...v5.7.0
